scope: Controlled sensitivity to errors added to existing estimated training poses on development scenes only

fixed.initialization: Immutable seed-42 post-BA reconstruction pair used by ba_operation_ablation_floor_v1
fixed.alignment: Fit from unperturbed training cameras before applying noise; never refit after perturbation

camera_radius_definition: Maximum Euclidean distance from a training camera center to the arithmetic mean of all 24 unperturbed training camera centers, in the normalized model frame
rotation_convention: For each non-anchor camera, left-multiply its camera-to-world rotation by a fixed-angle Rodrigues rotation about a noise-seed-determined axis in the model/world frame; camera center is unchanged
translation_convention: For each non-anchor camera, add a noise-seed-determined unit vector in the model/world frame times translation_fraction times camera_radius; orientation is unchanged
anchor: Training camera at parser index 0 is unchanged; expected names are DSCF5566.JPG for bonsai and DSCF4668.JPG for room
direction_pairing: Within each modality, both nonzero levels use noise_seed 1729 and therefore share per-camera axes/directions; only magnitude changes
zero_reuse_rule: Reuse only if snapshot, training fields, source behavior and evaluation protocol match; record immutable identity and hashes in the matrix receipt
interpretation_limits: This is sensitivity to controlled errors added to estimated poses, not known absolute pose error
There is no geometry ground truth, so no geometry accuracy is reported
One training seed and one noise-direction set do not support strong statistical generalization
The protocol is development-only and does not reopen final_v1
stopping_rule: Run exactly the frozen matrix within the authorized budget; do not change levels for monotonicity and stop after report and delivery validation
